entries.method: Final cumulative token_count total, not sum of cumulative events. Cached input subtracted from input. Reasoning already included in output; never added twice.
entries.scope: Entire isolated author session including setup and final report; excludes supervisor, verification and separate report agent.
entries.limitations: Codex local usage telemetry, not a billing response. Standard and Fast API equivalents only; subscription spend and resolved provider snapshot unavailable. Running snapshots exclude in-flight unreported usage.
